title: Probability of an Appended Event
statement: For natural numbers $b,m$, let $A$ be a property of finite Boolean lists. For a property $D$ of Boolean lists, let $P_k(D)$ denote the fraction of Boolean lists of length $k$ satisfying $D$. Then $P_{b+m}(A)=2^{-b}\sum_{u\in\{0,1\}^b}P_m(l\mapsto A(u\mathbin{+	hinspace+}l))$, where $u\mathbin{+	hinspace+}l$ denotes concatenation.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a decidable property of Boolean lists
